Please note that the following throughput limits apply to various APIs and Webhooks available as part of <<prodname>> Sandbox mode.

**Communication APIs** 

  * You can make a maximum of one API call every second to each of the SMS, Voice, and WhatsApp API individually. 
  * Apart from this, there is a lifetime usage limit of 10000 outbound messages on SMS and WhatsApp channels, and 5000 inbound and 5000 outbound calls on voice. 
  
**Custom Event API and Inbound Webhooks**

You can make a maximum of one API call every second to custom event API or inbound webhooks. This is an aggregate limit that applies to all your <<prodname>> custom event APIs or inbound webhooks. A maximum of 2500 calls can be made to custom event API or inbound webhooks within a month.
